blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing multi-agent collaboration (MAC) methods have primarily explored a group thinking collaboration topology, where agents independently generate solutions and aggregate their outputs. In this work, we investigate an alternative relay thinking topology, where reasoning ownership is dynamically transferred across agents, allowing subsequent agents to inherit and refine an evolving reasoning trajectory. We introduce Multi-Agent Confidence-guided Relay (MACR), a framework that enables dynamical relay collaboration among agents. The key challenge is determining when reasoning should be relayed and which agent should continue the process. method addresses this challenge through confidence-guided relay triggering and a bidding mechanism that selects the next agent based on its confidence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that method outperforms the strongest single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0x less token overhead on HallusionBench and MMStar.Further analysis demonstrates that relay collaboration enables heterogeneous agents to progressively integrate complementary insights, combining heterogeneous capabilities across reasoning stages. Our source code is available at https://github.com/67L1/MACR.
blocks.zh: 现有的多代理协作(MAC)方法主要探索了一个思考协作地理学的团体,其中代理独立生成解决方案并汇总其产出. 在这部作品中,我们调查了另一种中继思维的地貌学,其中推理所有权被动态地跨出代理,让后继代理继承并完善了不断发展的推理轨迹. 我们引入了多代理信任制导中继器(MACR),这个框架使各代理之间能够进行动态中继协作. 关键的挑战在于确定何时应进行推理,以及哪些代理人应继续这一进程。 方法通过信心引导接力触发和基于其信心选择下一个代理人的投标机制来应对这一挑战。 关于四项基准的实验表明,方法在准确性方面超过了最强的单一模式战略,例如,在MathVista和MMStar上分别是+3.3%和+3.9%,而且与多代理战略相同,同时在Hallusion Bench和MMStar上消耗6.0x更低的象征性间接费用。 进一步的分析表明,接力协作能够使各种因素逐渐融合互补的见解,将各种能力结合到各种推理阶段。 我们的源代码可查阅https://github.com/67L1/MCR.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of group thinking and relay thinking in MAC.
blocks.zh: 图1:MAC中分组思维和中继思维的比较.

blocks.en: Background. Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive reasoning capabilities ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) . However, when solving complex problems, a single model might encounter intermediate reasoning bottlenecks that limit further progress ( Shojaee et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . Multi-Agent Collaboration (MAC) has emerged as an effective approach to address such challenges by enabling multiple models to interact and exploit complementary capabilities ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Bajoria et al., 2026 ; Tran et al., 2025 ; Ferrag et al., 2026 ; Abou Ali et al., 2025 ; Gupta et al., 2025 ) . Existing studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of MAC in various domains, e . g ., mathematical reasoning ( Qian et al., 2025 ; Davoudi et al., 2025 ) , visual question answering ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , and multi-step decision making ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Nourzad et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 背景情况。 大语言模型(LLMs)表现出令人印象深刻的推理能力(Zhang等人,2025a); 徐等人,2025;刘等人,2026c.). 然而,在解决复杂问题时,单一模式可能会遇到限制取得进一步进展的中间推理瓶颈(Shojaee等人,2026年;Yan等人,2026年;Liu等人,2026年b). 多剂协作(MAC)已经形成一种有效办法,通过使多个模式能够互动和利用互补能力来解决这些挑战(Jin等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年b;Bajoria等人,2026年;Tran等人,2025年;Ferrag等人,2026年;Abou Ali等人,2025年;Gupta等人,2025年)。 现有研究表明MAC在多个领域的有效性,如:g.,数学推理(Qian等人,2025年;Davoudi等人,2025年),视觉问题回答(Wang等人,2026c;Wang等人,2026a),以及多步骤决策(Weng等人,2025年;Nourzad等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Motivation. Despite their diversity, most MAC methods follow a group thinking collaboration pattern ( Janis, 1982 ) , where multiple agents contribute reasoning trajectories in parallel and integrate information through interaction or aggregation ( Li et al., 2024 ; Veluri et al., 2024 ; Becker et al., 2026 ) ( cf . Fig. 1 a). This pattern enables agents to contribute parallel perspectives and reach a synthesized solution. However, collaboration among intelligent systems can take multiple forms. Cognitive science suggests another pattern of collective problem solving, referred to as relay thinking ( Michael, 1998 ; Van Eeckhout et al., 2025 ) , where one participant develops an intermediate idea and transfers it to another participant for further refinement. Inspired by this sequential knowledge transfer process, we explore a relay-style collaboration topology for MAC, where agents progressively inherit and extend a shared reasoning trajectory through sequential ownership transitions ( cf . Fig. 1 b).
blocks.zh: 动静. 尽管其多样性,大多数MAC方法都遵循一个群体思维协作模式(Janis,1982年),其中多个代理人平行贡献推理轨迹,并通过互动或聚合整合信息(Li等人,2024年;Veluri等人,2024年;Becker等人,2026年)(参见图1a). 这种模式使物剂能够提供平行视角,并达成综合解决方案. 然而,智能系统之间的合作可以采取多种形式。 认知科学提出了另一种集体问题解决模式,称为中继思维(Michael,1998年;Van Eeckhout等人,2025年),其中一位与会者提出了中间想法,并将其转给另一位与会者,以便进一步完善。 受这一相继的知识转让过程的启发,我们探索了MAC的中继式协作地形学,通过相继所有权的过渡,代理人逐渐继承和扩展共同推理轨迹(参见图1b).

blocks.en: Figure 2: KDE of local confidence across three models, before (a) and after (b) calibration.
blocks.zh: 图2:介于(a)和(b)校准之前和之后三种模式的 KDE 本地信任度 。

blocks.en: Methodology. Realizing relay collaboration requires addressing two questions: when should reasoning ownership be transferred, and which agent should continue the reasoning process. We use model confidence as a signal for these decisions, motivated by previous studies showing that confidence estimates can provide information about reasoning reliability ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ) . Moreover, we also observe in Fig. 4 that correct and incorrect trajectories are separable in confidence. However, confidence values derived from heterogeneous models are not directly comparable due to differences in model architectures, vocabulary spaces, and probability distributions ( cf . Fig. 2 ). To address this, we propose the M ulti- A gent C onfidence-guided R elay ( Macr ). Macr begins by extracting local confidence across a heterogeneous model pool using a sliding window for confidence calibration, reducing the Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) F F value from 13.31 13.31 to 1.01 1.01 ( cf . Fig. 2 ). On this basis of comparable confidence across heterogeneous models, Macr monitors the leading model’s calibrated confidence and interrupts generation to initiate bidding once that model shows low confidence, relaying generation rights to the model with the highest confidence. Besides deciding when and to whom to relay, Macr must also determine which model should start the task. To this end, it initializes the leading model via an initial bidding round, selecting the model with the highest calibrated confidence to start the task. These steps together constitute Macr ’s online “initiation–monitoring–bidding–relay” loop ( cf . Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 方法论. 实现中继协作需要解决两个问题:何时应转让推理所有权,以及哪些代理人应继续推理过程。 我们利用模型信任作为这些决定的信号,其动机是以前的研究表明,信心估计可以提供关于推理可靠性的信息(徐等人,2026年;王等人,2026年b;Farquhar等人,2024年)。 此外,我们还在图4中指出,正确和不正确的轨迹在保密情况下是分开的。 然而,由于模型架构,词汇空间,以及概率分布的差异(参见图2),不同模型产生的置信值无法直接比较. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议采用M ulti -- -- A gent C incidence-guided R elay(Macr)。 Macr公司首先利用滑动窗口进行信心校准,从一个不同的模型池中提取当地信心,将差异分析(ANOVA)F值从13.31 13.31降至1.01 1.01(参见图2)。 以此为基础,Macr监测了领先模型的校准信心,一旦模型显示信心低,就中断了竞标,以最有信心的方式将生成权传递给模型。 除了决定何时和向谁接力外,Macr还必须确定哪个模型应该开始任务. 为此,它通过初步的招标回合初始化了领先的模型,选择了具有最高校准信心的模型开始任务. 这些步骤共同构成Macr的在线 " 启动-监测-投标-重复 " 循环(参见图3)。

blocks.en:
Contributions. First, we offer a new perspective on MAC patterns by drawing on relay thinking , where a reasoning trajectory is progressively refined and synthesized as it is relayed across heterogeneous models.
Second, we develop Macr , a confidence-guided relay framework that calibrates confidence across heterogeneous models and jointly determines model initiation and reasoning handoffs through bidding.
Third, we reveal two empirical properties underlying effective heterogeneous collaboration: models exhibit complementary strengths across reasoning stages, while reasoning bottlenecks emerge at different stages across tasks. We hope these findings motivate dynamic model scheduling that adapts both reasoning ownership and relay timing throughout inference.
blocks.zh:
捐款。 首先,我们从中继思维的角度对MAC模式提出新的观点,在这种思维中,推理轨迹随着各种模型的中继而逐步完善和综合。
第二,我们开发了Macr,这是一个以信任为指南的中继框架,它校准不同模型之间的信心,并通过招标共同决定模型启动和推理。
第三,我们揭示了有效多样协作的两个经验属性:模型在各种推理阶段表现出互补的优势,而推理瓶颈则在不同阶段出现。 我们希望这些结论能够激励动态模式的时间安排,使推理所有权和接力时间贯穿整个推论。

blocks.en: Results and Analysis. Experiments on four multimodal benchmarks show that Macr outperforms single-model strategies in accuracy, e.g., +3.3% on MathVista and +3.9% on MMStar, and remains on par with multi-agent strategies while consuming 6.0 × \times fewer tokens on HallusionBench and MMStar, respectively. Qualitative analysis reveals that Macr integrates the isolated cues of single models into a global reasoning chain( cf . § 3.3 ). Furthermore, our analyses confirm that heterogeneous models in Macr are complementary, both across their capabilities ( cf . Fig. 6 a) and across reasoning stages( cf . Fig. 6 b), and that they are capable of localizing task-agnostic bottlenecks( cf . Fig. 6 c).
blocks.zh: 成果和分析。 对四个多式联运基准的实验表明,Macr在精确度上超过了单模型策略,例如MathVista的+3.3%和MMStar的+3.9%,并且仍然与多代理策略相当,而Hallusion Bench和MMStar分别消耗6.0×\%的代号. 定性分析显示,Macr将单个模型的孤立提示整合到全球推理链中(参见第3.3节)。 此外,我们的分析证实,Macr中的各种模型是相辅相成的,既包括能力(参见图6a),也包括推理阶段(参见图6b),它们能够将任务不可知瓶颈本地化(参见图6c)。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: Macr requires determining two things. First, it requires the real-time identification of local reasoning bottlenecks. While a model’s logarithmic probabilities indicate its confidence, we find that their confidence is incomparable. Therefore, models’ confidence needs calibration to enable cross-model bidding. Second, it must evaluate which candidate model is best suited to take over generation. Candidate models perform short trial generations on a shared context, and Macr evaluates their confidence under the calibrated metric to execute handovers.
blocks.zh: Macr需要确定两件事 一,要求实时识别本地推理瓶颈. 虽然一个模型的对数概率表明了它的信心,但我们发现他们的信心是无可比拟的。 因此,模型的信心需要校准才能进行跨模型招标。 第二,它必须评价哪种候选人模式最适合代代相传。 候选模型在共同的上下文上进行短期试验,Macr根据执行移交的校准度量标准评价其信心.

blocks.en: Consequently, the implementation of Macr is naturally divided into two sequential phases: i ) Establish a well-calibrated confidence metric offline, ensuring reliable comparability among heterogeneous models (§ 2.1 ); ii ) Establish an online scheduling workflow comprising “initiation–monitoring–bidding–relay” stages to facilitate real-time collaboration (§ 2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 因此,Macr的执行自然分为两个相继阶段: (单位:千美元) 建立经适当校准的离线信任度度表,确保各种模型之间的可靠可比性(第2.1节); 建立包括 " 启动-监测-投标-重复 " 阶段的在线调度工作流程,以促进实时合作(第2.2节)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Heterogeneous Model Confidence Shift Analysis and Calibration
blocks.zh: 2.1 异质模型信任移分析和校准

blocks.en: Confidence Shift Analysis. Macr collaborates over a model pool ℳ \mathcal{M} of three models ( Qwen3 VL , InternVL 3.5 , Minicpm-V 4.5 ). We randomly sample 1,000 instances from MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) and allow these models to perform reasoning. To obtain local confidence rather than sequence confidence for identifying reasoning bottlenecks, given a model m ∈ ℳ m\in\mathcal{M} and its generated logarithmic probability sequence c i c_{i} , we define a sliding window of size w w to calculate the local confidence: W i , m ( w ) = 1 w ​ ∑ j = 0 w − 1 c i − j . W_{i,m}^{(w)}=\frac{1}{w}\sum\nolimits_{j=0}^{w-1}c_{i-j}. (1) We then extract three models’ W m ( w ) W_{m}^{(w)} and visualize them via Kernel Density Estimation (KDE). The KDE visualizations show the distributions of the three models, where we observe clear shifts among them ( cf . Fig. 2 a).

blocks.en: To formally verify this, we conduct a one-way analysis of variance (ANOVA). The F F -value measures the ratio of between-group variance to within-group variance, quantifying whether a difference exists among the confidence distributions of the three models: F = 1 k − 1 ​ ∑ m = 1 k n m ​ ( x ¯ m − x ¯ ) 2 1 N − k ​ ∑ m = 1 k ∑ i = 1 n m ( x m ​ i − x ¯ m ) 2 , F=\frac{\frac{1}{k-1}\sum_{m=1}^{k}n_{m}(\bar{x}_{m}-\bar{x})^{2}}{\frac{1}{N-k}\sum_{m=1}^{k}\sum_{i=1}^{n_{m}}(x_{mi}-\bar{x}_{m})^{2}}, (2) where k k is the number of candidate models, n m n_{m} is the sample size for model m m , N N is the total sample size, x ¯ m \bar{x}_{m} is the confidence mean for the model m m , and x ¯ \bar{x} is the overall mean. The experiment yielded F = 13.31 F=13.31 ( F ≫ 1 F\gg 1 ), confirming that between-group differences significantly outweigh within-group random noise. This demonstrates that their raw confidence is mathematically incomparable.

Confidence Calibration. To eliminate the shift, a standardization method based on historical sliding window distributions is employed. Specifically, we aggregate the local confidence samples W ( w ) W^{(w)} generated by each model on a historical reference dataset. This yields the local baseline mean μ m ( w ) \mu_{m}^{(w)} and standard deviation σ m ( w ) \sigma_{m}^{(w)} for window size w w . During generation, each model’s local confidence is transformed into a standardized metric: Z i , m ( w ) = W i , m ( w ) − μ m ( w ) σ m ( w ) . Z_{i,m}^{(w)}=\frac{W_{i,m}^{(w)}-\mu_{m}^{(w)}}{\sigma_{m}^{(w)}}. (3) Subsequently, the ANOVA is conducted to verify the removal of shift ( cf . Fig. 2 b). The KDE distribution redrawn with standardized data shows that the curves of the three models align around 0. Quantitatively, the F-value drops to F = 1.01 F=1.01 ( F ≈ 1 F\approx 1 ), indicating that between-group differences are reduced to the level of intra-model random noise, such that the shift across models is eliminated.
blocks.zh: 信心校准. 为了消除这种转变,采用了基于历史滑动窗口分布的标准化方法。 具体地说,我们汇总了每个模型在一个历史参考数据集上生成的W(w)W(w)}本地置信度样本. 这样得出了当地基准值的μ m (w)\mu_{m}^{(w)}和\sigma_{m}^{(w)}对窗口大小 W 的标准差 。 在一代人的时间里,每个模型的本地信心被转化为一个标准化的度量标准:Z i, m (w) = W i, m (w) – μ (w) → m (w) _{ _{, m (w) }=\ frac{ W_{i, m}^{(w)}- mu_{ m}^{ (w) }}{\ }}{\ sigma_{ m}^{ (w) }}. (3) 随后,进行ANOVA,以核实班次的取消(参见图2b)。 KDE 分布与标准化数据的重新绘制显示,三种模型的曲线对应于 0 左右. 从数量上看,F值下降到F=1.01 F=1.01(F 1 F\约1),表示组间差异缩小到模型内随机噪声的水平,从而消除跨模型的转变.

blocks.en: Figure 4: KDE of standardized local confidence grouped by correctness.
blocks.zh: 图4:按正确性分类的标准化本地信任的 KDE 。

blocks.en: Furthermore, grouping the standardized data by correctness and visualizing their distributions via KDE ( cf . Fig. 4 ) reveals that correct trajectories exhibit higher local confidence. This separability is consistent with prior studies ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ) , jointly confirming that a low confidence indicates a model encountering a bottleneck. Consequently, the historical expected mean and standard deviation for each model m m are adopted for cross-model calibration in the scheduling phase.
blocks.zh: 此外,通过正确性和通过 KDE 可视化其分布来组合标准化数据(参见图4)表明,正确的轨迹显示出了较高的本地信心。 这种可分离性与之前的研究一致(徐等人,2026年;王等人,2026年b;法克哈尔等人,2024年),共同证实低信任度表示模型遇到瓶颈. 因此,在日程安排阶段采用每个型号 m 的历史预期平均偏差和标准偏差来进行跨型号校准。

blocks.en: 2.2 Online Bidding and Relay Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 网上投标和中继生成

blocks.en: Macr applies the calibrated confidence metric (§ 2.1 ) to identify local bottlenecks during models’ generation, executing the “initiation–monitoring–bidding–relay” loop mechanism.
blocks.zh: Macr应用校准的置信度量度(§2.1)来识别模型生成过程中的局部瓶颈,执行"启动-监测-投标-中继"循环机制.

blocks.en: Monitoring. The leading model m ∗ m^{*} then performs standard autoregressive generation. At each time-step t t , Macr monitors the local confidence and calibrates it to Z t , m ∗ ( w ) Z_{t,m^{*}}^{(w)} : Z t , m ∗ ( w ) = 1 w ​ ∑ j = 0 w − 1 c t − j − μ m ∗ ( w ) σ m ∗ ( w ) . \quad Z_{t,m^{*}}^{(w)}=\frac{\frac{1}{w}\sum_{j=0}^{w-1}c_{t-j}-\mu_{m^{*}}^{(w)}}{\sigma_{m^{*}}^{(w)}}. (5) The sliding window calculation enables the identification of reasoning bottlenecks in real-time. Building on the separability of correct trajectories ( cf . Fig. 4 ), we define a threshold τ \tau . If the leading model’s confidence drops below this threshold ( Z t , m ∗ ( w ) < τ Z_{t,m^{*}}^{(w)}<\tau ), Macr determines it encounters a reasoning bottleneck, halting its generation to trigger the bidding.

Bidding. Macr synchronizes the current context X t X_{t} to each model m ∈ ℳ m\in\mathcal{M} , prompting it to generate a w w -token candidate sequence T m = { t m , 1 , t m , 2 , … , t m , w } T_{m}=\{t_{m,1},t_{m,2},\dots,t_{m,w}\} . Evaluating their confidence, Macr selects the model m ∗ m^{*} that maximizes the calibrated confidence: m ∗ = arg ⁡ max m ∈ ℳ ⁡ ( 1 w ​ ∑ j = 1 w log ⁡ p m ​ ( t m , j ∣ X t , t m , < j ) − μ m ( w ) σ m ( w ) ) . m^{*}=\arg\max_{m\in\mathcal{M}}\big(\frac{\frac{1}{w}\sum_{j=1}^{w}\log p_{m}(t_{m,j}\mid X_{t},t_{m,<j})-\mu_{m}^{(w)}}{\sigma_{m}^{(w)}}\big). (6) Relay. X_{t+w}=X_{t}\oplus T_{m^{*}}. (7) Macr then relays generation ownership to m ∗ m^{*} and resumes monitoring ( cf . Eq. 5 ) until completion. The algorithm flow is presented in Alg. 1 .

blocks.en: 3 Experiment
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets.​ To evaluate Macr across diverse dimensions, we adopt four benchmarks. MMStar ( Chen et al., 2024 ) evaluates comprehensive multi-modal capabilities across 6 abilities and 18 tasks. HallusionBench ( Guan et al., 2024 ) diagnoses the visual and knowledge hallucinations. LogicVista ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) assesses structured reasoning in visual contexts, covering inductive, deductive, numerical, spatial, and causal logic. MathVista ( Lu et al., 2024 ) evaluates joint visual-mathematical reasoning across geometry, charts, and word problems.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 为了从不同方面评价Macr,我们采用四个基准。 MMStar(Chen等人,2024年)评价了6个能力和18个任务的全面多式联运能力. Hallusion Bench (Guan et al., 2024))诊断视觉和知识幻觉. LogicVista (Xiao et al., 2024)在视觉背景下评估结构化推理,涵盖引力,推论,数值,空间和因果逻辑. 数学维斯塔 (Lu et al., 2024)评价跨几何,图表,和词问题的联合视觉-数学推理.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare Macr against single-model and multi-agent strategies. The model pool consists of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and MiniCPM-V-4.5-8B ( Yu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们把Macr比作单一模式和多代理策略. 该模型池由Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct(杨等人,2025a)组成. , InternVL3.5-8B(Wang等人,2025b),和MiniCPM-V-4.5-8B(Yu等人,2026年).

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Single-Model Strategies. We evaluate standard input–output prompting ( IO ), where the model directly outputs the solution and answer from the given images and question; CCoT ( Mitra et al., 2024 ) prompts the LLM to generate a scene graph capturing objects, attributes, and their relationships first, and then uses that scene graph to produce the final response; and DDCoT ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) decomposes complex problems into actionable sub-tasks and then produces the final answer.
blocks.zh: * 启动单一模式战略。 我们评价标准输入-输出提示(IO),即模型直接输出解决方案,并从给定的图像和问题中解答;CCoT(Mitra等人,2024年)促使LLM先生成一个场景图,捕捉对象,属性及其关系,然后使用场景图生成最终响应;DDCoT(郑等人,2023年)将复杂的问题分解为可操作的子任务,然后生成最终答案.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Multi-Agent Strategies. We benchmark against two multi-agent strategies: Majority Vote ( MV ) ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , establishing consensus across independent model generations, and H-DMAD ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , a diverse multi-agent collaboration framework that assigns different reasoning strategies ( CoT ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , CCoT , and DDCoT ) to different agents, encouraging complementary perspectives to break the fixed mental set, and fuses their outputs into a final answer.
blocks.zh: * 启动多代理战略。 我们参照两个多代理战略: 多数投票(MV)(Wang等人,2023年),建立独立模范世代的共识,H-DMAD(Liu等人,2025年),一个多样化的多代理合作框架,将不同的推理战略(CoT(郑等人,2023年),CCoT,DDCoT)分配给不同的代理商,鼓励互补视角打破固定的心理组合,并将产出融入最终答案.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We set the sliding window size w = 16 w=16 and the confidence threshold τ = − 0.3 \tau=-0.3 via parameter search on 600 randomly sampled instances from RealWorldQA ( X.AI, 2024 ) , which are disjoint from all evaluation sets. All evaluations are conducted under identical settings ( e . g ., temperature). To ensure reliability and rule out the influence of generation randomness, we conduct all evaluations with three distinct random seeds. We report accuracy as the mean ± \pm standard deviation, and additionally report token usage along with the Incremental Benefit per Cost (IBC), defined as Δ ​ Acc / Δ ​ Tokens \Delta\text{Acc}/\Delta\text{Tokens} relative to each single model’s IO baseline ( Aggarwal et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 执行详情。 我们通过对来自RealWorldQA(X.AI,2024)的600个随机抽样实例进行参数搜索,设置了滑动窗口大小w=16 w=16,置信阈值\\\ = 0.3\ tau=-0.3,这些实例与所有评价集脱节。 所有评价都是在相同的环境(例如温度)下进行的。 为确保可靠性和排除生成随机性的影响,我们用三个明显的随机种子进行所有评价. 我们报告精确度为平均±\pm标准差,另外报告符号使用量,以及每个模型的IO基线(Aggarwal 等人,2024年),定义为 cc /\ Delta\text{Acc}/\Delta\text{Tokens}。

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance of MLLMs in terms of accuracy (%), token overhead and IBC ( × 10 − 6 \times 10^{-6} ).
blocks.zh: 表1: MLLMs在准确性(%)、象征性间接费用和中型散货箱方面的性能(X 10 - 6\times 10 - 6})。

blocks.en: 3.2 Quantitative Comparison Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 定量比较结果

blocks.en:
The results demonstrate that Macr consistently surpasses single-model strategies in accuracy while remaining comparable to multi-agent strategies with minimal token overhead ( cf . Table 1 ). Macr yields substantial accuracy gains over the strongest single-model strategies, boosting performance by +3.30% on MathVista (78.00% vs. 74.70%) and +3.87% on MMStar (72.00% vs. 68.13%). It secures these enhancements while maintaining commensurate or reduced token overhead. For instance, Macr demands only 4,150 tokens on MMStar, while single-model strategies like CCoT and DDCoT consume 5,434 and 5,227 tokens, respectively.
Furthermore, while multi-agent strategies achieve comparable accuracy, their token overhead is far higher. Macr operates with 6.00 × \times fewer tokens on HallusionBench (4,414 vs. 26,375) and MMStar (4,150 vs. 24,677). To quantify the efficiency gain of Macr , we evaluate the IBC ( Aggarwal et al., 2024 ) . Macr dominates IBC across all datasets with a state-of-the-art IBC of 21.35, e . g ., boosting performance by +18.52 on MMStar (21.35 vs. 2.83) and +12.75 on MathVista (15.38 vs. 2.63) over H-DMAD , substantiating that relay thinking successfully maximizes collective intelligence while preventing generation waste.
blocks.zh:
结果表明,Macr一贯准确超越单一模式战略,但仍与多代理战略相比,象征性间接费用很少(见表1)。 Macr对最强的单型战略的精确度有很大提高,在MathVista(78.00%对74.70%)和MMStar(72.00%对68.13%)上提高了+3.30%的性能。 它保证这些改进,同时保持相应的或减少的象征性间接费用。 例如,Macr只在MMStar上要求4,150个令牌,而CCoT和DDCoT等单型战略则分别消耗5,434个和5,227个令牌.
此外,虽然多代理战略的准确性相当,但其象征性间接费用却高得多。 Macr在Halliusion Bench(4 414 vs 26 375)和MMStar(4 150 vs 24 677)上运行的标志数量较少,只有6.00x\\时间. 为了量化Macr的效率收益,我们评价了IBC(Aggarwal等人,2024年)。 Macr在H-DMAD上主导所有数据集的中型散货箱,最先进的中型散货箱为21.35,例如,在MMStar上(21.35 vs. 2.83)提升了+18.52的性能,在MathVista上(15.38 vs. 2.63)提升了+12.75的性能,证明了中继思维在防止产生浪费的同时成功地实现了集体智能的最大化。

blocks.en: 3.3 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 定性分析

blocks.en: We compare Macr reasoning trajectories against those of single-model CoT. In cases where CoT fails ( cf . Fig. 5 , left), single models anchor on isolated cues ( e . g ., local textures or lighting attributes), whereas Macr succeeds by synthesizing these fragmented cues into a more comprehensive global view. This advantage extends to failure cases where both methods produce an incorrect answer ( cf . Fig. 5 , right). Even then, Macr still attempts a comprehensive integration, whereas CoT focuses on an isolated patch. This indicates that Macr enhances the generation quality by executing global contextual integration, even when the underlying model pool reaches its capability ceiling.
blocks.zh: 我们比较Macr推理轨迹 和单型CoT的轨迹 在CoT失败的情况下(参考图5,左侧),单个模型锚定在孤立的提示上(例如,局部纹理或照明属性),而Macr则通过将这些零碎提示合成一个更全面的全局视图而成功. 这种优势扩大到两种方法都产生错误答案的失败情况(参见图5,右)。 即便如此,Macr仍然试图进行全面整合,而CoT则专注于一个孤立的补丁. 这表明,Macr公司通过实施全球背景整合来提高生成质量,即使基本的模型库达到其能力上限。

blocks.en: 3.4 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 分析

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative comparison between single-models’ CoT and Macr .
blocks.zh: 图5:单一型号CoT和Macr的定性比较。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Capability Routing Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 能力路线分析

blocks.en:
To validate the necessity of bidding, we analyze the cross-model transition matrix ( cf . Fig. 6 a).
The row-normalized transition probabilities reveal bidirectional relay dynamics. While MiniCPM-V 4.5 has the highest self-transition rate (59.7%), it still yields dominance to InternVL 3.5 or Qwen3 V L in 40.3% of its bids.
Furthermore, bidirectional exchanges between peers are frequent. InternVL 3.5 transfers to Qwen3 VL (22.4%), while Qwen3 VL returns control (26.9%).
This indicates that no single model maintains absolute dominance. Instead, it demonstrates that they complement each other. By leveraging calibrated local confidence, Macr matches each bottleneck with its optimal model.
Our ablation findings corroborate this complementarity ( cf . § 3.4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
为了证实投标的必要性,我们分析了跨模型过渡矩阵(参见图6a)。
行态化的过渡概率揭示出双向中继动态. 虽然MiniCPM-V 4.5的自转率最高(59.7%),但在其40.3%的投标中,它仍然将主导权给予InternVL 3.5或Qune3 VL。
此外,同行之间经常进行双向交流。 InternVL 3.5转至Quen3 VL(22.4%),而Quen3 VL返回控制(26.9%).
这表明,没有一个单一的模式保持绝对的支配地位。 相反,这表明它们相辅相成。 通过利用校准的本地信心,Macr将每个瓶颈与其最佳模式匹配.
我们的研究结论证实了这种互补性(参见第3.4.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Inference Survival Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 推断生存分析

blocks.en:
To quantify the continuous generation capability of models, we conduct a Kaplan-Meier survival analysis ( cf . Fig. 6 b). MiniCPM-V 4.5 shows the highest early survival, with a number at risk (3,151) roughly twice that of the other two models (1,163 and 1,658). InternVL 3.5 maintains a plateau during later stages, demonstrating long-horizon retention, whereas Qwen3-VL exhibits the poorest long-horizon retention.
This indicates that models excel at different stages of generation. Unlike traditional turn-based strategies that may either disrupt long-horizon reasoning or cause early-survival models to accumulate hallucinations during later stages, Macr relays generation according to each model’s stage-wise retention.
Consistent with these temporal dynamics, employing punctuation-based fixed triggers degrades performance ( cf . § 3.4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
为了量化模型的连续生成能力,我们进行了Kaplan-Meier生存分析(参见图6b)。 MiniCPM-V 4.5显示早期存活率最高,有3 151人处于危险中,大约是另外两种型号(1 163人和1 658人)的两倍。 InternVL 3.5在后期保持高原,显示长视距保留,而Qune3-VL显示的则是最贫穷的长视距保留。
这表明模型在不同的生成阶段都非常出色。 传统的回合制策略可能破坏长视推理,或导致早期存活模型在后期积累幻觉,与这种策略不同,Macr根据每个模型的阶段性保留进行中继生成.
与这些时间动态相一致的是,使用以点动为基础的固定触发器会降低性能(参见第3.4.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Task-Agnostic Bottleneck Location Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 任务不可知博特连克位置分析

blocks.en:
To validate that Macr is task-agnostic, we analyze the distribution of bidding triggers across different tasks ( cf . Fig. 6 c).
The distributions reveal contrasting relay patterns across datasets. While logic-heavy tasks (LogicVista, MathVista) exhibit dense relays in the early stage, visual-intensive tasks (MMStar, HallusionBench) concentrate their relays in later stages. Furthermore, across all tasks, bidding frequency consistently stabilizes during the final stage as models converge on final answers. Macr localizes these task-agnostic bottlenecks, adapting to the unique reasoning paradigms of different domains. If Macr adopts task-blind periodic relays, accuracy degrades ( cf . § 3.4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
为了验证Macr的任务不可知性,我们分析了不同任务之间投标触发因素的分布情况(参见图6 c)。
分布显示各数据集的对应中继模式. 虽然逻辑重的任务(LogicVista,MathVista)在早期表现出密集的中继功能,但视觉密集的任务(MMStar,Hallusion Bench)在后期集中了它们的中继功能. 此外,在所有任务中,随着模型在最后答案上的趋同,投标频率在最后阶段一直保持稳定。 Macr将这些任务不可知瓶颈本地化,适应不同领域的独特推理范式. 如果Macr采用任务盲周期继电器,准确性就会下降(参见第3.4.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study of Macr .
blocks.zh: 表2:Macr的读取研究

blocks.en: To verify the necessity of Macr ’s initiation, capability matching and bottleneck localization, we ablate the respective modules on 500 randomly sampled instances from MMStar.
blocks.zh: 为了验证Macr的启动、能力匹配和瓶颈本地化的必要性,我们放弃了MMStar500个随机抽样的模块。

blocks.en: Initiation. The initial leading model is fixed to each of the three models in turn while keeping the rest of the pipeline unchanged (Fixed Initiation, FI ). FI achieves 71.6%, 71.2%, and 70.4% for MiniCPM-V 4.5 , InternVL 3.5 , and Qwen3 VL , respectively, compared with Macr ’s 72.4%. This shows that confidence-guided initialization outperforms any fixed pattern.
blocks.zh: 启动 最初的领先型号依次固定在三个型号的每个型号上,同时保持其余管道不变(Fixed Instroduction, FI .). 与Macr的72.4%相比,FI分别实现了71.6%、71.2%和70.4%的MiniCPM-V4.5、InternVL3.5和Qune3 VL。 这表明,信心引导初始化比任何固定模式都要好。

blocks.en: Capability Matching. The selection mechanism ( cf . Eq. 6 ) is replaced with a fixed routing order ( MiniCPM-V 4.5 → \rightarrow InternVL 3.5 → \rightarrow Qwen3 VL ) (Fixed Selection, FS ). FS degrades accuracy from 72.4% to 69.0%. Aligning with the bidirectional exchanges observed in capability routing analysis ( cf . § 3.4.1 ), fixed routing fails to exploit the models’ complementarity.
blocks.zh: 能力比对. 选择机制(参见Eq. 6)被固定的路由顺序(MiniCPM-V 4.5 →\右翼InternVL 3.5 →\右翼Quen3 VL)所取代(Fixed Setch, FS ). FS的精度从72.4%下降到69.0%. 固定路线与能力路线分析中观察到的双向交换一致(参见第3.4.1节),未能利用模型的互补性。

blocks.en: Bottleneck Localization. Confidence-guided bidding ( cf . Eq. 5 ) is replaced with fixed bidding at every sentence boundary (Fixed Trigger, FT ). FT degrades accuracy from 72.4% to 69.8%. It is consistent with our findings in inference survival ( cf . § 3.4.2 ) and bottleneck location analysis ( cf . § 3.4.3 ): FT truncates the reasoning chains of long-horizon models while accumulating hallucinations from short-horizon ones, and it cannot adapt to task-specific characteristics.
blocks.zh: 博特伦克本地化. 每个句子边界(Fixed Trigger,FT )以固定投标取代信任制投标(参见Eq 5). FT的精度从72.4%降低到69.8%. 它符合我们在推断存活率(参见§3.4.2)和瓶颈位置分析(参见§3.4.3): FT缩短了长视距模型的推理链,同时积累了短视模型的幻觉,无法适应特定任务的特点.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Analysis experiments of Macr ’s performance.
blocks.zh: 图6:Macr性能分析实验.

blocks.en: 3.4.5 Analysis on Model Pool Heterogeneity
blocks.zh: 3.4.5 模型池异质性分析

blocks.en: Table 3: Analysis on model heterogeneity. All results are reported in Acc. (%).
blocks.zh: 表3:模型异质性分析。 Acc.报告所有结果(%)。

blocks.en: To validate the necessity of diversity within the model pool, we restrict Macr ’s model pool to a single homogeneous model ( MiniCPM-V 4.5 , InternVL 3.5 , or Qwen3 VL ) and evaluate two homogeneous multi-agent collaboration pattern variants on 500 randomly sampled instances from MMStar ( cf . Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了验证模型池内多样性的必要性,我们将Macr的模型池限制在一个单一的单一模型(MiniCPM-V 4.5, InternVL 3.5, 或 Qune3 VL)中,并对MMStar500个随机抽样实例的两个单一的多代理协作模式变体进行评价(参见表3)。

blocks.en: Role-Playing Pattern ( RPH ) prompts a single model with three distinct personas: a Proponent proposing the initial reasoning and answer, an Opponent formulating rebuttals and alternative perspectives, and a Mediator resolving conflicts ( Lu and Su, 2026 ) . RPH achieves 68.0%, 70.2%, and 64.8% for MiniCPM-V 4.5 , InternVL 3.5 , and Qwen3 VL , respectively, compared with Macr ’s 72.4%. This shows that simulated persona diversity fails to match true architectural complementarity.
blocks.zh: 角色扮演模式(RPH ) 催生了一个具有三个不同人物的单一模型:一个支持者提出初步推理和答案,一个反对者提出反驳和另类观点,以及一个调解者解决冲突(Lu and Su, 2026 ) 。 与Macr的72.4%相比,RPH分别实现了68.0%、70.2%和64.8%的MiniCPM-V4.5、InternVL3.5和Qune3 VL。 这表明模拟人物的多样性与真正的建筑互补性不符。

blocks.en: Temperature-Decoded Pattern ( TDH ) simulates intra-model diversity by elevating the sampling temperature during the bidding phase, generating three distinct reasoning paths. The trajectory that maximizes local confidence is then adopted and concatenated to the context. TDH yields 66.6%, 68.8%, and 63.6% for MiniCPM-V 4.5 , InternVL 3.5 , and Qwen3 VL , underperforming Macr . This shows that sampling strategies cannot substitute for complementary heterogeneity.
blocks.zh: 温度分解模式(TDH)通过在招标阶段提高采样温度来模拟模型内部的多样性,产生三个截然不同的推理路径. 然后采用最大限度增强当地信心的轨迹,并根据具体情况加以调整。 TDH的产量为66.6%,68.8%,MiniCPM-V4.5、InternVL3.5和Qune3 VL的产量为63.6%,表现不佳的Macr。 这表明,取样战略不能取代互补的异质性。

blocks.en: The results indicate homogeneity leads to performance degradation. Consistent with recent findings ( Bertalanič and Fortuna, 2026 ) , homogeneous pools lack intrinsic diversity and thus cannot produce cognitive diversity. Conformity tendency may drive them to converge on a flawed consensus.
blocks.zh: 结果表明同质性导致性能退化. 根据最近的调查结果(Bertalanič和Fortuna,2026年),同质集合缺乏内在多样性,因此无法产生认知多样性。 符合性的趋势可能促使它们达成共识。

blocks.en: 3.4.6 Lexical Profiling of Reasoning Bottlenecks
blocks.zh: 3.4.6 理性瓶体的表征分析

blocks.en: To semantically characterize models’ reasoning bottlenecks, we analyze the lexical distribution of tokens generated immediately preceding a bidding trigger (cf. Fig. 7 ). The resulting distributions show distinct lexical patterns across models. InternVL predominantly falters around analytical evidence extraction (e.g., analyze, examine, identify ), MiniCPM-V around spatial localization and attribute binding (e.g., position, top, left, large ), and Qwen3-VL around causal deduction (e.g., since, therefore, suggesting ). Despite these differences, all models share a universal hesitation signature, frequently outputting stall tokens (e.g., wait, look, check ). This lexical heterogeneity aligns with the complementarity we observed (cf. § 3.4.1 ), suggesting that different models tend to hesitate at different stages and motivating Macr ’s design of matching each bottleneck with its optimal model.
blocks.zh: 为了准确描述模型的推理瓶颈,我们分析了在投标触发点之前产生的代币的词汇分布(参见图7)。 由此产生的分布显示了不同模型的鲜明的词汇模式。 InternVL主要围绕分析证据提取(如分析,检查,识别),MiniCPM-V围绕空间定位和属性约束(如位置,上,左,大),Qune3-VL围绕因果扣减(如,因此建议). 尽管有这些差异,所有模型都有一个通用的犹豫符号,经常输出悬浮符号(如等待,看,检查). 这种异质性符合我们观察到的互补性(参见第3.4.1节),这表明不同的模型往往在不同阶段犹豫不决,并激励Macr设计每个瓶颈与其最佳模型相匹配。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) improves performance by leveraging interactions among LLMs. Existing MAD methods are broadly categorized into two streams.
The first category is Collaboration Workflow Optimization ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Maiga et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Pham et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Zhang and Xiong, 2025 ) . These methods structure multi-agent collaboration to resolve tasks, e . g ., orchestrating role-based coordination pipelines ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Maiga et al., 2025 ) , communicating via continuous embeddings ( Pham et al., 2024 ) , and optimizing communication topologies or multi-perspective reward frameworks ( Li et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Zhang and Xiong, 2025 ) .
The second category is Failure Diagnosis and Intervention ( Wynn et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2026 ; Choi et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2025b ) . These methods diagnose and mitigate collaborative limitations, e . g ., quantifying sycophancy and social conformity to prevent premature convergence ( Wynn et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) , establishing taxonomies for system misalignments ( Cemri et al., 2026 ) , and delineating theoretical bounds of debate under test-time scaling ( Choi et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2025b ) . Despite their impressive performance, these methods are all built around the topology of group thinking , where models produce complete responses that are aggregated after generation.
blocks.zh:
多代理辩论(MAD)通过利用法学硕士之间的相互作用来提高业绩。 现有的MAD方法大致分为两组。
第一类是协作工作流优化(Hong等人,2024年;Maiga等人,2025年;Li等人,2024年;Pham等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年;Li等人,2023年;Zhang and Xiong,2025年). 这些方法构建了多代理协作,以解决任务,如:g.,协调角色协调管道(Hong等人,2024年;Maiga等人,2025年),通过连续嵌入进行沟通(Pham等人,2024年),优化通信地形或多视角奖励框架(Li等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年;Li等人,2023年;Zhang and Xiong,2025年).
第二类是失败诊断和干预(Wynn等人,2025年;姚等人,2025年;Cemri等人,2026年;Choi等人,2026年a;Yang等人,2025年b)。 这些方法诊断并减轻了协作限制,例如,用数量表示共性和社会一致性,以防止过早的趋同(Wynn等人,2025年;Yao等人,2025年),建立系统错位分类(Cemri等人,2026年),并划定试验时间尺度下辩论的理论界限(Choi等人,2026a年); 杨等人,2025b.). 尽管这些方法表现令人印象深刻,

blocks.en: Unlike methods relying on rigid debate turns, Macr monitors confidence in real time and relays generation rights to the most confident candidate when a model struggles.
blocks.zh: 和依赖僵硬辩论的方法不同 Macr监视实时的信心,当一个模型挣扎时将生成权传递给最有信心的候选人.

blocks.en:
Uncertainty and Confidence in LLMs provide signals for evaluating confidence and guiding reasoning. These approaches are broadly divided into two main streams.
The first category is Uncertainty Quantification and Decomposition ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Jayasekera et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Amayuelas et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026c ) . They decompose and estimate uncertainty to evaluate confidence or trigger behaviors,   establishing bounds or benchmarks for uncertainties ( Jayasekera et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , inducing uncertainty awareness through query or tuning ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Amayuelas et al., 2024 ) , and extracting token-level logit margins to dynamically trigger interleaved multimodal reasoning ( Liu et al., 2026c ) .
The second category is Confidence-Guided Collaboration and Reinforcement ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Ai et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Pappu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Choi et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Park et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . They manage uncertainty within multi-agent frameworks, e . g ., modulating belief updates through confidence scores ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Ai et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , mitigating behavioral uncertainties like hallucination, compromise, or bias during debates ( Pappu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Choi et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) , and optimizing collaborative policies via translating confidence into reward signals ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Park et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Despite quantifying uncertainties and optimizing collaborative policies, these methods evaluate sequence-level outputs and overlook the comparability of confidence across heterogeneous models.
blocks.zh:
有限责任措施的不确定性和信心为评价信心和指导推理提供了信号。 这些方法大致分为两大流.
第一类是不确定性量化和分解(Wang等人,2025a;Jayasekera等人,2026;Feng等人,2025;Amayuelas等人,2024;Liu等人,2026c)。 它们分解和估计不确定性以评价信心或触发行为,确定不确定性的界限或基准(Jayasekera等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年a),通过查询或调试诱导不确定性意识(Feng等人,2025年;Amayuelas等人,2024年),并提取符号级的对数边以动态触发互离式多模式推理(Liu等人,2026年c)。
第二类是信任引导协作与强化(Zhu等人,2026年;Ai等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年;Pappu等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年a;Choi等人,2026年b;Li等人,2026年b;Liu等人,2026年a;Park等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年). 它们通过信任分数(Zhu等人,2026年;Ai等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年)管理多种代理人框架内的不确定性,减轻辩论中的行为不确定性,如幻觉、妥协或偏见(Pappu等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年a年;Choi等人,2026年b年;Li等人,2026年b年b年),并通过将信任转化为奖励信号优化合作政策(Liu等人,2026年a年; Park et al., 2025; Zhao et al., 2026).
尽管对不确定性进行了量化,优化了合作政策,但这些方法评价了序列级产出,忽略了不同模型之间信任的可比性。

blocks.en: Unlike these methods, we first identify the incomparability of confidence across heterogeneous models and provide a calibration method for it. Building on this, Macr calibrates local confidence at the window level rather than sequence level, monitoring mid-generation uncertainty and executing cross-model relays the moment a local reasoning bottleneck is detected.
blocks.zh: 与这些方法不同,我们首先确定不同模型之间信任的不可比较性,并提供了一种校准方法。 在此基础上,Macr校准了窗口层面而非序列层面的本地信心,监测中代不确定性,并在发现本地推理瓶颈时执行跨模型中继.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Macr , transitioning multi-agent collaboration from group thinking mode to relay thinking mode. Addressing incomparable confidence across heterogeneous models, Macr calibrates local confidence, enabling real-time cross-model bidding. Monitoring the leading model, Macr interrupts generation upon detecting reasoning bottlenecks, transferring generation rights to the most confident model. Experiments across four multi-modal benchmarks demonstrate that Macr outperforms all existing single-model baselines in accuracy, while achieving results comparable to existing multi-agent baselines with 6.0 × \times less token overhead. Further analyses verify that this relay mechanism integrates isolated cues into comprehensive global reasoning chains and exploits model complementarity, with a task-agnostic selection mechanism.
blocks.zh: 我们引入Macr,将多代理协作从分组思维模式向中继思维模式过渡. Macr解决了各种模式之间不可比拟的信心问题,调整了当地的信心,使实时跨模式招标成为可能。 监测主模型,Macr在发现推理瓶颈时中断生成,将生成权转移到最自信的模型. 跨越四个多模式基准的实验表明,Macr准确地超越了所有现有的单一模式基线,同时取得的结果与现有的多代理基线相当,比6.0x\时间少象征性的间接费用。 进一步的分析证实,这种中继机制将孤立的提示纳入全球综合推理链,并利用模型的互补性,以及任务不可知的选择机制。
